component: Account Hub OAuth warning localization phase

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing adds two Fluent messages and translator context only. It references the brand term and a named help link but leaves Advanced Configuration and Account Settings as literal wording rather than interpolated message references. A later accepted warning banner uses those IDs, and later widget code controls its visibility. That consumer and policy are separate from the preparatory string phase. No translation/rendering, support-link, OAuth, account or accessibility result was tested.
title: The Account Hub OAuth warning messages land before their UI consumer
